tools.name: get_estimate
tools.description: Get a NON-BINDING ferry-flight price estimate between two airports for an aircraft. Returns a full fee breakdown, distance/flight-time, and a booking_url.

tools.name: search_aircraft
tools.description: Search aircraft models by manufacturer/model/type. Returns faa_code to pass to get_estimate.

tools.name: get_aircraft
tools.description: Full specs for one aircraft model (performance, capacity, powerplant, capabilities).

tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Search airports by code/name/city. Returns ICAO/IATA codes + coordinates.

tools.name: get_airport
tools.description: Airport detail including runways and frequencies.

tools.name: search_airports_near_zip
tools.description: Find general-aviation airports within a radius of a US ZIP code, ordered by distance (nearest first). Returns each airport with distance_nm. Useful for "what airports are near me / near 07666".

tools.name: search_registry
tools.description: Search the FAA aircraft registry by N-number prefix and/or manufacturer/state/year (FAA-public data).

tools.name: get_registration
tools.description: FAA registration detail for one N-number (FAA-public data: model, engine, year, status).

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Great-circle distance + FAA preferred route + optional ferry planning (fuel stops, flying days) for an aircraft.

tools.name: get_live_flights
tools.description: Recently observed live ADS-B flights tracked by FerryFlight.
